analysis.definition: A project has a local library problem when an HTML script src identified as a library resolves to a local path that does not exist. A project has a remote library problem when an HTTP/HTTPS script src returns an HTTP response other than 200. Request failures such as timeout, DNS, connection, or TLS errors are kept separately as inconclusive.
analysis.local_library_identification: Known local library filenames are derived from paths.json -> libraries_locations.
analysis.remote_check: HTTP GET with redirects enabled. HTTP 200 is available; other HTTP status codes are unavailable; request/network errors are inconclusive.
